summary: Show a tenant-scoped list of captured analytics events, with their validation status and payload details.
decisions: Captured event payloads are stored in the selected tenant database.
The first slice is read-only; editing tracking configuration is out of scope.

tickets.title: Define captured event and validation result types
tickets.goal: Represent captured events and validation results without application or browser dependencies.
acceptance: Types represent event name, timestamp, source URL, payload and validation status.
Invalid or incomplete payloads have an explicit result instead of being silently dropped.
Domain tests cover valid and invalid event examples.

tickets.title: Render event list and payload details
tickets.goal: Make captured events inspectable by name, time and validation result.
acceptance: The list shows event name, timestamp, source and validation status.
Selecting an event reveals its payload and validation findings.
Empty and invalid-event states are visible in a component test.

tickets.title: Add tenant-scoped inspector route
tickets.goal: Load captured events from the active tenant database and display the inspector.
acceptance: The App Router page resolves the tenant before querying events.
The page uses the shared UI package and never queries a different tenant database.
Tests cover authorized access, missing tenant context and the empty state.
